fusions.name: Drifting Down
fusions.desc: Puffs a cone of loose down 4 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, each hit with a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Plucked Pinion
fusions.desc: Plucks a feather loose and flicks it, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Combed Oil
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% and your water resistance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Snarled Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
